metadata.upcoming_ceremony_note: Next annual MICHELIN Guide Northeast Ceremony is scheduled for December 14, 2026 in Manhattan (prior to the Feb–Mar 2027 trip). Star counts below reflect the official active NYC selection verified Nov 25, 2026: 70 starred restaurants in NYC (5 Three-Star, 14 Two-Star, 51 One-Star) plus 84 Bib Gourmand and MICHELIN Selected restaurants. Two Westchester County properties (Blue Hill at Stone Barns 2★, Tarrytown; La Bastide by Andrea Calstier 1★, North Salem) exceed 60 minutes by NYC subway/bus and are excluded from NYC hotel transit counts.
